mech: Value that lives only while it moves: what is used and passed on grows, what is left standing loses its strength.
napeti: Hodnota, kterou máš, žije jen pohybem: co se používá a jde dál, roste; co stojí, ztrácí sílu.
obrazy: The food you were saving for a special day is past its date.
The battery you never use is flat on the day you need it.
The bicycle left in the shed all year needs a repair before it will move.

mech: Raw bodily strength that shows only when it is needed: a weight or resistance gives way to a force that was already there.
napeti: Síla, o které nevíš, dokud ji nepotřebuješ: něco, co vypadalo nepohnutelně, povolí.
obrazy: The jar lid will not move until you put your full grip behind it.
The packed suitcase will not lift until you bend your knees and take its weight.
The stuck window gives when you lean into the frame with both hands.

mech: The sharp edge at a threshold: something stops a move just before it is made, and the stop protects or shows what the rush would have missed.
napeti: Okamžik mezi impulsem a činem: něco ostrého tě zastaví těsně před krokem — a právě to zastavení chrání.
obrazy: You have typed the angry reply, and your thumb stops above the send button.
You start to interrupt, see the other has not finished, and close your mouth.
You reach to post the photo, then notice someone in it who never agreed.

mech: A word or sound that arrives and changes something: speech heard at the right moment gives a thing its name or its meaning.
napeti: Slovo, které už možná zaznělo mnohokrát, a teprve teď je slyšet — a tím se něco změní.
obrazy: One person says, "I thought I was the only one," and the table goes quiet.
You say the decision out loud, and it suddenly sounds different.
One sentence in the voice message tells you the plan has changed.

mech: A road made by going: step follows step, a rhythm is found only by moving, and the question is whether the way still leads where one means to go.
napeti: Cestu dělají kroky, ne plán — a snadná cesta tě může nést dál, než kam jsi chtěl.
obrazy: The path across the grass is on no plan; it is where everyone actually walks.
On the long drive you miss your turning because the road was so easy to follow.
A few lengths in, your strokes find a rhythm you no longer count.

mech: A small light that reveals: something that was there all along gets a shape, and once seen it cannot be unseen; a flame that needs feeding.
napeti: Malé světlo ukáže, co tu bylo celou dobu — i to, co bys raději neviděl; a oheň bez péče zhasne.
obrazy: Your phone torch finds the dropped key in the dark under the seat.
You change the hallway bulb and see a crack in the ceiling.
The idea comes mid-walk, and you stop to record it before it goes.

mech: A gift between two sides: something leaves one hand and is received by another, and what arises between them belongs to both and is not counted.
napeti: Dar, který nikdo nepočítá, a přece mezi dvěma něco založí: obě strany dávají i přijímají.
obrazy: You bring a dish to the shared dinner and go home carrying someone else's.
The borrowed dish comes back with something baked in it.
One friend brings the coffees, and the other has kept a seat.
You hold the door, and the stranger behind you holds the next one for you.

mech: A moment when things fall into place and lighten: shared joy in the middle of things, not a reward for finishing.
napeti: Nic se nevyřešilo, a přece je to lehčí: radost uprostřed práce nebo nepohody, ne až po ní.
obrazy: Halfway through the dishes a song comes on, and you both sing along.
The train is late again, and you two start rating the vending-machine snacks.
The birthday cake leans, and the child asks for the piece sliding off.

mech: An uninvited force from outside breaks what looked solid: the plan falls apart, and afterwards it shows what is gone and what held.
napeti: Co nikdo nezval, rozbije, co vypadalo pevně — a teprve potom je vidět, co zbylo.
obrazy: The flight is cancelled at the gate, and the group chat fills with new plans.
A power cut ends the video call and takes the unsaved slide with it.
After the burst pipe the new ceiling is down, and the old counter still stands.

mech: Lack and constraint: something is missing or cannot be had, and the pressure shows what is truly needed.
napeti: Teprve když něčeho není dost, je vidět, co je opravdu potřeba.
obrazy: The phone is at two per cent, and you send the one message that matters.
One seat is left on the last bus, and it goes to the person on crutches.
Before the water is shut off you fill one bottle.

mech: Standstill: something that was moving has stopped and is held as it is, and in the stillness one thing stays in view.
napeti: Owner 2026-11-14: něco, co by se normálně pohybovalo, je teď zastavené — a to zastavení má konkrétní důsledek.
obrazy: The waterfall has become a wall of ice, its last streams held against the rock.
A chain of bubbles rises through the dark water, then stops beneath the clear ice.
A drop has frozen at the tip of an icicle, just before it falls.
The lift stops between floors, and everyone inside falls quiet.

mech: Time that does the work: what was done long before ripens at its own pace and shows as a result that cannot be hurried.
napeti: Dlouho není nic vidět a nejde to uspíšit — a pak se ukáže výsledek toho, co bylo uděláno dávno.
obrazy: The sapling you planted by the bench now shades the place where you sit.
You answer in the new language before you have time to translate the question.
The small monthly payments finally cover the cost of the course.

mech: Holding through change: something bends, stands between two states or endures a long strain, and does not break.
napeti: Všechno kolem se mění nebo tlačí, a jedna věc drží — ohne se, ale nezlomí.
obrazy: A gust turns the umbrella inside out, and you push it back into shape.
The old wooden chair creaks under your weight, bends a little, and holds.
The phone case splits when it hits the floor, and the screen beneath is whole.

mech: The closed vessel: something exists but is not yet shown or known — not "nothing", but "not yet".
napeti: Obsah existuje, ale je zavřený: ne „nic nevím“, ale „ještě nevím“ — a otevřít to dřív by to pokazilo.
obrazy: A parcel arrives with no sender, and the label gives no clue what is inside.
A voice memo is saved as "Untitled", and you cannot recall what you said.
The result is ready in the app, but the notification shows no number.

mech: Guarding alertness: something watches or stands between a threat and what it protects, open to the world yet letting not everything in.
napeti: Otevřené světu, a přece hlídá: pustí dovnitř jen něco — a tím to, co je uvnitř, ochrání.
obrazy: The door opens on its chain, just far enough to see who is knocking.
You share your location with your family and not with the group chat.
You mute the work chat overnight and leave family calls switched on.

mech: The sun's light and strength: it simply shines, and by it one sees where one stands; too bright, it dazzles.
napeti: Slunce nic nevysvětluje, jen svítí — a najednou je vidět, kde stojíš; příliš ostré oslní.
obrazy: The fog lifts, and the trail marker you were walking toward appears.
After the power cut the apartment block lights up window by window.
You open the curtains and can finally read the colour on the sample card.

mech: A direction that costs something: taking one side or keeping one's word and paying the price for it knowingly.
napeti: Nejde stát na všech stranách: jeden směr vybereš a víš, co tě to stojí.
obrazy: Everyone agrees the mistake should be reported, and you put your name on the form.
You tell the referee the ball was out, and your own team loses the point.
You refuse the promotion that rests on your colleague's work.

mech: New small life and the care that lets it grow: something fragile begins, and is given room rather than forced.
napeti: Malé není slabé — a péče znamená dát tomu místo, ne do toho sahat.
obrazy: The child struggles with the zip, and you wait while they try again.
The child ties the lace wrong, and your hand stays in your pocket.
The seedling droops in its new pot, then opens one fresh leaf toward the window.

mech: Movement made by two: progress that comes only when two find a common rhythm and neither forces the other.
napeti: Pohyb vznikne až ve chvíli, kdy ani jeden netlačí: dva najdou společný krok.
obrazy: On the tandem the wobble stops when both riders settle into one pace.
Two carry a long mirror through the doorway: one pauses, the other turns.
Two people work the long saw in turn, and the blade moves cleanly.

mech: The person among people: one sees oneself in or through others, as in a mirror.
napeti: Sám sebe vidíš až v druhých: oni ukážou to, co zevnitř vidět nejde.
obrazy: You hear your own phrase come out of a friend's mouth and learn how it sounds.
A friend calls you patient, and you have never thought of yourself that way.
A friend copies the way you tap your foot, and you never knew you did it.

mech: Water and what moves under the surface: something is sensed before it can be explained, or a hidden current finds its own way.
napeti: Víš to dřív, než to umíš vysvětlit: pod klidnou hladinou se něco hýbe a určuje směr.
obrazy: Your foot moves to the brake before you have named what is wrong.
You lower your voice when your friend goes quiet, before either of you knows why.
You keep looking at the same patch of ceiling before any leak appears.

mech: Ripening inside: from outside nothing seems to happen while something completes itself within, closed until it is ready.
napeti: Zvenku se neděje nic, uvnitř všechno: je to zavřené a hotové to bude, až to bude hotové.
obrazy: The dough rests under a tea towel, and by morning it has doubled.
The file downloads overnight while the screen shows nothing happening.
After days of practising alone, the first sentence comes out ready.

mech: What is inherited and where one returns: things, ways and places handed down, and the choice of what to carry on.
napeti: Co jsi dostal, a co z toho neseš dál: něco zděděného pořád slouží, něco už nepasuje.
obrazy: You follow your grandmother's recipe card and add the change your family made.
The old key still opens the shed at your parents' house.
You mend your coat on the sewing machine your mother taught you to use.

mech: The turn from dark to light: a shift after which the same world looks different and cannot be seen the old way.
napeti: Nic se nepohnulo, a přece je všechno jinak: pohled se otočí a zpátky už to nejde.
obrazy: You turn the map on your phone, and the street falls into place.
One ordinary sentence from its sender makes you read the whole message differently.
At dawn the street that felt strange in the dark is the one you know.

mech: The unmarked: no sign, no name yet — an open space where meaning has not been written.
napeti: Prázdné místo není chyba: znak tu ještě není, a co se tam vloží moc rychle, zakryje, co se teprve ukazuje.
obrazy: A new document is open, and the first line is still yours to choose.
The form asks for a detail it never explains, and you leave the box blank.
The new flat has one empty wall, and you have not decided what belongs there.
